note: Mischievously Drinkable (Elysian Brewing, Oct 1 - Dec 31, 2026): requires one of four specific Elysian Dust Series beers (Space Dust IPA, Juice Dust Juicy IPA, Phaze Dust Hazy IPA, Easy Dust Non-Alc IPA) - a brewery/specific-beer match, not a style or country match, so special_badges.json's reader (kind: style/country only) can't compute this.

Punchtöberfest (Oct 1-31, 2026, sponsored by Punch Cigars): criteria is 'check in any beer ... in the USA only', which reads as a check-in VENUE location restriction, not a brewery-country match - badge_stats.compute_special_badges' 'country' kind matches a beer's own country field (brewery origin), so this isn't the same thing and can't be safely encoded as kind: country without risking false positives for e.g. a US drinker checking in a German import.

NC Beer Month Passport (Oct 1-31, 2026): four separate badges (Welcome + Level 1/2/3) requiring check-ins at 1/5/10/15 distinct North Carolina breweries respectively - a venue-location (state) + distinct-brewery-count match, not a style or country match, so special_badges.json's reader (kind: style/country only) can't compute this.

Scream-Worthy Hard Cider (sponsored by Angry Orchard, Oct 17-31, 2026): requires checking in the specific product 'Angry Orchard Crisp Apple Hard Cider' - a specific-beer match, not a style or country match, so special_badges.json's reader (kind: style/country only) can't compute this.

Champagne Day (2026) (Oct 23-25, 2026): criteria is check in any one sparkling-wine style from a large 'sparkling group' - confirmed catalog leaves like 'Wine - Champagne Blend', 'Wine - Cava Blend', 'Wine - Glera (Prosecco)', 'Wine - Glera - Pinot Noir', 'Wine - Lambrusco', 'Wine - Sparkling - English Sparkling Wine', 'Wine - Sparkling - Franciacorta' exist on untappd.com/beer/top_rated, but the post also lists many further grape-variety styles (Brachetto, Crémant-type blends, and a long tail like Alphonse Lavallée/Arbane/Avana/Corvinone/Durella/etc.) whose exact current taxonomy leaf names and 'Wine - X' vs 'Wine - Sparkling - X' prefixing weren't confidently verified for every entry - risk of an incomplete or mismatched styles[] list, so not added to special_badges.json. Also only active for 2 more days (through Oct 25).

Untappd 16th Anniversary (Oct 22-31, 2026): criteria is simply 'check in any drink' during the window - no style or country restriction at all, so there's nothing for badge_stats.compute_special_badges' kind:style/kind:country matcher to filter on (every check-in would trivially qualify); this schema has no 'any' kind to encode that.
